classification.difficultyReason: Interpret 'how much more' as subtraction and rewrite one fraction with the other's denominator. Supplied aligned models make the differences visible.

spec.description: Equal-length bars aligned at both ends: seven of nine upper cells shaded green and one of three lower cells shaded orange, with a red double-headed difference arrow between the shaded endpoints.
spec.mathematics: Both bars represent the same whole. The difference extends from one third to seven ninths, a length of four ninths.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied quantities and comparison arrow remain visible; the numerical answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{7}{9}-\frac{1}{3}&=\frac{7}{9}-\frac{3}{9}\\&=\frac{4}{9}\end{align*}$$
The arrow spans four of the nine equal parts.

spec.description: Two number lines on a common scale. The upper blue hatched interval represents three eighths; the lower red hatched interval represents three quarters. Every supplied tick and label is retained, with a dotted vertical guide at three eighths.
spec.mathematics: Three quarters is six eighths; the interval between three eighths and six eighths has length three eighths.
spec.answerVisibility: Source intervals, labels and comparison guide remain visible; the numerical answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{3}{4}-\frac{3}{8}&=\frac{6}{8}-\frac{3}{8}\\&=\frac{3}{8}\end{align*}$$
The number lines show a difference of three eighths.
